title: The bird on the dead S
logline: The Lanes' sign by day, and the bird on the S, the first letter to go dark, in 2010. Every color on the dead tube. The page doesn't add the joke.

panels.composition: A bowling alley's sign in flat daylight with its tubes gray and the small rainbow bird perched on the first letter, the roofline, the empty lot.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bowling alley's unlit neon sign in flat daylight with its tubes gray glass and a small rainbow bird perched on the first letter, an empty lot below, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
